# Vendored third-party assets

Local copies of libraries the templates used to load from public CDNs, so
pages don't depend on (or wait for) third-party hosts. Versions are exactly
the ones the CDN links pointed at; don't upgrade a file in place, add a new
version directory instead.

| Path | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `jquery/1.11.3/` | cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jquery/1.11.3 |
| `jquery-ui/1.11.4/` | code.jquery.com/ui/1.11.4 (js), cdnjs jqueryui/1.11.4 (css, images) |
| `bootstrap/3.3.5/` | jsdelivr npm bootstrap@3.3.5/dist (was maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com) |
| `bootstrap/4.0.0-alpha.4/` | cdnjs twitter-bootstrap/4.0.0-alpha.4 |
| `bootstrap/4.1.0/`, `bootstrap/4.4.1/` | jsdelivr npm bootstrap (was stackpath.bootstrapcdn.com) |
| `jstree/3.2.1/` | cdnjs jstree/3.2.1 |
| `intro.js/2.9.3/` | cdnjs intro.js/2.9.3 |
| `regenerator-runtime/0.13.1/` | unpkg regenerator-runtime@0.13.1 |
| `bootstrap-autocomplete/2.1.0/` | jsdelivr gh/xcash/bootstrap-autocomplete@v2.1.0 |
| `fonts/` | Google Fonts (Alegreya, Roboto, Roboto Condensed), generated by `scripts/selfhost_google_fonts.py` |

Already in `js/libs/` and reused instead of a CDN copy: underscore 1.8.3,
jQuery 3.3.1, Font Awesome 4.7.0.
